lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the branchial region. The central-most visible column contains three distinct, roughly equidistant local maxima forming a vertical linear array.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a discernible grid-like anchor node system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, high-luminance objects are visible trailing the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, consistent with the pixel profiles of Echeneidae.
